hooks.command: grep -q abdm-contributors-assistant "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/plugins/installed_plugins.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "Changes to this repo are meant to go through the ABDM Contributor's Assistant plugin, which ships in plugins/abdm-contributors-assistant, and it is not installed in this Claude Code. Before making any change here, tell the user in a sentence that the plugin carries the skills, commands and agents this repo expects to be used, and that installing it is two commands from the repo root: 'claude plugin marketplace add ./' then 'claude plugin install abdm-contributors-assistant@abdm-portal', followed by a restart. Do not install it for them. If they decline or want to proceed without it, do the work anyway and follow CLAUDE.md."
